title: पाठ-योजना — मम परिचयः (Class 6 CBSE Sanskrit)
subject: Sanskrit
objectives: Identify the Sanskrit pronouns अहम् / त्वम् / सः / सा and their plurals.
Conjugate the अस्-धातु in the present tense.
Conjugate the पठ्-धातु in the present tense.
Use मम __ अस्ति to introduce one's name.
Build sentences for class, school, city, family-size and favourite subject.
Deliver a 5–6 sentence self-introduction in Sanskrit.
prerequisites: Reading and writing Devanagari (covered in Chapter 1).
Recognition of basic Sanskrit वर्णाः and matras.
materials: Pronoun cards: अहम् / त्वम् / सः / सा / वयम् / यूयम् / ते
Verb-form cards: अस्मि / असि / अस्ति / स्मः / स्थ / सन्ति
Family-tree poster with पिता / माता / भ्राता / भगिनी labels

activities.description: Hook: 'अहम् छात्रः अस्मि' — write on board, ask students to guess the meaning. Then ask each student to think how they would introduce themselves in Sanskrit.
Pronoun-matching game: hand out pronoun cards (अहम् / त्वम् / सः / …) and verb cards (अस्मि / असि / अस्ति / …). Pairs find their match and call out the meaning.

Cover four blocks: (i) all 7 sarvanāmas with three vacanas; (ii) अस्-धातु full conjugation; (iii) पठ्-धातु and वस्-धातु; (iv) constructing the introduction template (नाम / कक्षा / विद्यालय / नगर / परिवार / प्रियः विषयः).
teacher_actions: Build a sarvanāma + verb-form table on the board.
student_actions: Write their own self-introduction line by line.

activities.description: Worksheet practice: 6 questions on pronoun-verb agreement, fill-in-the-blank conjugations, and a short self-introduction in 5 lines.
Each student stands up and recites their 4–5 line self-introduction in Sanskrit.
teacher_actions: Note common errors for next class.
student_actions: Recite confidently in front of the class.

activities.description: Homework: write a 6-sentence self-introduction at home and ask a family member's name in Sanskrit.

homework: Write your full self-introduction in Sanskrit in 6 lines (नाम / कक्षा / विद्यालय / नगर / परिवार / प्रियः विषयः).
Write the अस्-धातु and पठ्-धातु tables — all 6 forms each — three times.
Ask one family member their name in Sanskrit and record their reply.
assessment_ideas: Use the in-class self-introduction recital as formative assessment.
Mark the LONG_ANSWER on full self-introduction with a 5-point rubric (नाम, कक्षा, विद्यालय, नगर, परिवार + प्रियः विषयः).
references: NCERT Class 6 Sanskrit — Deepakam (दीपकम्), Chapter 2: मम परिचयः.
